title: Poll check
description: The payload of an inbox item of kind poll_check: a blind second entry of a poll that has an open proposal, made from the notice or the pollster's publication without reading the proposal's numbers. It is a full poll (poll.schema.json, checked too) that must also say who entered it, so the pipeline can refuse a check from the run that made the proposal. Never written to the repository: when it matches, the proposal is committed unchanged.
